feeds.title: The Joy Of Wood Blog
feeds.description: The Joy Of Wood Blog is managed by a wood workshop school which discusses the school's focus on traditional woodworking skills and techniques. The school offers workshops for people of all ages and experience levels. Students learn to use hand tools to make a variety of wood projects.

feeds.title: Planit
feeds.description: Planit Australia offers industry-leading software tools for the woodworking industry with CABINET VISION, Vortek Spaces and Leica measuring devices. From coast to coast we work in tune with Australian businesses to equip them with solutions to suit all specific needs. CABINET VISION Design supports sales profitability by creating professional, accurate designs, renderings, and pricing estimates that work specifically to your needs.

feeds.title: The Lost Scrolls of Handwork
feeds.description: This is a journal of the art of woodworking by hand. I hope you join me on this wonderful journey which is an adventure in this wonderful craft of woodworking and share my experiences as a craftsman, it's joy, it's trials and tribulations, it's frustrations & it's beauty and art and most importantly the learning experience. Blog by Salko Safic.

feeds.title: Australian Woodwork Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to the Australian Woodwork Blog, where you'll find the latest news about our company and our products. We are one of Australia's leading online gift store that specialises in the retail of fine woodwork, made by Australia's leading artisans and designer/makers utilising sustainable, Australian native timbers.

feeds.title: Paul Sellers Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Paul Sellers' Website!This site is Paul Sellers' woodworking blog and acts as a platform for his online voice.Here is info about the ventures Paul is involved with, and many blog posts filled with knowledge he has gained throughout his lifetime.Paul considers himself to be a lifestyle woodworker, woodworking is his passion. You can read more about how he started his journey by reading his biography.

feeds.title: Two Sheds Workshop Blog
feeds.description: Two Sheds Workshop runs woodwork and building classes and workshops for women, children and teenagers. The Two Sheds Workshop Blog features a variety of content related to woodworking and building skills. It includes personal stories of people involved with Two Sheds.

feeds.title: Wood Tamer Blog
feeds.description: The Wood Tamer blog has been created for spoon carvers and carvers in general. We feature stories on Australian timbers to carve, carving tools and also interviews with some of our favourite carvers and tool makers. We hope you enjoy the articles.

feeds.title: Wood Dust Blog
feeds.description: Woodworking is a universal craft adored by people everywhere. And Wood Dust 23 is an event that brings these people together. A place where the first-timer can hold a real hand plane, take a class, and buy some quality tools. Where the enthusiast can meet their heroes, have a yarn, and hone their skills. And the professional can share their experiences with those eager to learn more. Follow the Wood Dust Blog and learn more about the event, the activities, people participating, related news, and updates.

feeds.title: Ausworkshop Blog
feeds.description: Ausworkshop is one of Australia's finest wooden boxes wooden signs & custom-made gifts. They are woodworkers specializing in wooden signs and fine woodwork including hardwood boxes and custom-made treasures. Providing tips on websites and tech articles.
